description: Sets a new password for a Sitecore user. Supply either 'oldPassword' (validated before the change) or 'resetPassword: true' (an administrative reset that does not need the current password) — SPE offers no third way to change a password.

identity.description: The identity of the user to update the password for (e.g. 'admin' or full path 'sitecore\admin')

newPassword.description: The new password for the user

oldPassword.description: The user's current password, validated before the change. Supply this or 'resetPassword: true'.

resetPassword.description: Administrative reset: change the password without knowing the current one. Supply this or 'oldPassword'.

name: security-set-user-password
